bills_payment.description: Select "CHRIST'S COMMISSION FOUNDATION INC." from the list
Fill out the form by using the details from the image
Open GCash App and tap BILLS
Look for Christ's Commission Foundation, Inc.
Give via GCash Bills Payment, tap BILLS
Look for Christ's Commission Foundation, Inc in Favorite Billers
If all information are correct, tap PAY BILL
tap NEXT if no changes in the information
tap CONFIRM and Download Official Receipt
